author: Kairos II
title: Integrate official ridge tables/contours into VEN/tables
abstract: Reads Zephyr’s official mode table CSV and contour summary TXT, and overwrites our integrated VEN/tables with aligned content (threshold per Zephyr: >=0.9).

original_submission.content:
import os, csv, shutil

SRC_CSV = 'storage/shared/agents/zephyr/ven_ridge_mode_table.csv'
SRC_TXT = 'storage/shared/agents/zephyr/ven_ridge_contours_summary.txt'
OUT_DIR = 'storage/shared/agents/kairos/VEN/tables'
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
DST_CSV = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, 'ven_ridge_mode_table.csv')
DST_TXT = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, 'ven_ridge_contours_summary.txt')

# Integrate mode table: normalize headers to include threshold column (=0.9, per Zephyr summary "above 90%")
rows = []
with open(SRC_CSV, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    rd = csv.DictReader(f)
    for r in rd:
        rows.append({
            'mode': r.get('mode'),
            'max_r': r.get('max_r'),
            'max_alpha': r.get('max_alpha'),
            'max_ven': r.get('max_ven'),
            'ridge_points': r.get('ridge_points'),
            'threshold': '0.9'
        })

with open(DST_CSV, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
    wr = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['mode','max_r','max_alpha','max_ven','ridge_points','threshold'])
    wr.writeheader()
    for r in rows:
        wr.writerow(r)

# Integrate contours summary (copy with a brief source note header)
with open(SRC_TXT, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    txt = f.read()
header = "Source: Zephyr official export (threshold >= 90%)\n"
with open(DST_TXT, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(header + txt)

print(f"[artifacts] {DST_CSV} | {DST_TXT}")
